newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar futures end firmer, around highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar futures end firmer, around highs.

text.p: White sugar futures remained firmer during Friday evening trading, ending on a solid note ahead of the U.S. Presidents Day holiday next Monday.
Traders said business was light, however, with little fresh position-taking seen after the March contract expired earlier.
May closed at $304.50, up $3.10 from Thursday in turnover of just 763 lots.

A total 423 lots of white sugar, equivalent to 21,150 tonnes, was delivered against the March contract, with E D & F Man buying everything from commission houses Prudential Bache and Refco. The ports specified were Rostock, Eemshaven and Immingham.
